description: This file defines the CartFragment class and related UI components for displaying and managing shopping cart items in an Android app. It handles rendering of cart items, quantity updates, removal, and navigation to checkout.

classes.name: CartFragment
classes.description: Main fragment displaying shopping cart, observing cart data, and handling navigation to checkout.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing cart items display within a RecyclerView.

classes.name: CartViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual cart item views, handling UI updates and user interactions.

methods.name: CartFragment.onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView, observes ViewModel, and configures checkout button.

methods.name: CartFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the CartFragment.

methods.name: CartAdapter.submit
methods.description: Updates the list of cart items and refreshes the display.

methods.name: CartViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a CartItem to the ViewHolder views, setting texts and images.
